description: issue #689: `set_tempo 90` (Sound profile, arity 1) emits exactly one `sound` event with payload {command:"set_tempo", beats_per_minute:90}, AFTER the tempo state has been scheduled (spec/interaction-events.md#trace-stream-integration). `note`/`play`/`rest` durations are 'interpreted in beats at the current tempo' by replay tools (spec/interaction-events.md:284-285), which read that tempo from this event; durations are never wall-clock, and the stream is deterministic and headless.
